Game Overview

In Pixel Battle Upward, the core idea is straightforward: push your opponent into the lava while dodging falling rockets in this frantic duel with a 120-second timer. Quick reflexes and strategic moves are your allies in this fast-paced, two-player showdown. Dive into charming pixel art environments where timing and cunning are your keys to victory!
